findings.problem: ScheduleRevision.actorUserId/actorMembershipId have no stated FK or validation rule; the coder could invent a composite FK that the append-only precedents (student_profile_history, academic_calendar_day_revisions, audit_events) deliberately omit.
findings.fix: State in §6.10 that actorUserId/actorMembershipId on schedule_revisions are recorded id columns with NO FK, mirroring student_profile_history and AuditEvent.actorUserId. One sentence; no schema change.

findings.problem: The DayOfWeek ordinal (SUN=0..SAT=6) is asserted in a comment but the Postgres enum carries no numeric meaning; only DOW_INDEX enforces it. No live bug, but a future DB-side weekday comparison could diverge.
findings.fix: Add one line to §8.2 stating the ordinal convention lives only in DOW_INDEX and getUTCDay(), and that no SQL compares dayOfWeek numerically (the enum is a label; integers live in the service).

findings.problem: InstitutionConfig.workingDaysOfWeek is Json in the DB (default [1,2,3,4,5,6]); §8.1 types it number[] without noting the route must parse/guard it the way allowance-engine.ts does (Array.isArray, map(Number), filter 0..6, fallback). A malformed config could throw inside the pure function.
findings.fix: Note in §8.1/§8.3 that the route coerces workingDaysOfWeek to a validated number[] (reusing the allowance-engine guard shape) before building ConflictContext.

findings.problem: The dry-run endpoint POST /api/classes/timetables/:id/check is not assigned a permission key; it sits between classes.view and classes.timetable.manage.
findings.fix: State that /check is gated by classes.timetable.manage (part of the authoring flow, reveals nothing a manager cannot already see). One line in §7 or §8.3.
